description: Place copies of items or stories on a page, in this or another open document, as linked content that updates when the source changes (Edit > Place and Link; the Content Placer tool)

layer.description: Layer to place on (default the source's layer, if the target document has it)

linkItems.description: Create Link for page items: the copies stay linked to their source

linkStories.description: Create Link for stories: the copied stories stay linked to their source

mapStyles.description: Map Styles: apply the custom style mappings (manage_style_mappings) to the copies

target.description: The source items (text frames place their stories)

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

toDocument.description: Name of another open document to place into (default the active document)

x.description: mm from the left of the page (default the source's position on its own page)

y.description: mm from the top of the page (default the source's position on its own page)

name: place_linked_copies
title: Place Linked Copies
